name: … the same junctions near the route as Overpass (all 20 within 15 m of route points, ≤ 1 m, same branch counts), none extra, same proposed turns
eval: const ov = await loadJunctionsOverpass({ onProgress: () => {}, cancelled: () => false }); const route = trackLines[0].pts; const near = (j) => route.some(p => p.distanceTo(j.latlng) <= 15); const O = ov.filter(near), V = gen.junctions.filter(near); const missing = O.filter(o => !V.some(v => v.latlng.distanceTo(o.latlng) <= 1)).length; const extra = V.filter(v => !O.some(o => o.latlng.distanceTo(v.latlng) <= 1)).length; const branchesEqual = O.every(o => { const v = V.find(v => v.latlng.distanceTo(o.latlng) <= 1); return v && v.branches.length === o.branches.length; }); const sig = (r) => r.add.map(c => c.idx + ':' + c.type).join(','); const sameTurns = sig(computeTurns(gen, ov)) === sig(gen.result); return { overpassNear: O.length, missing, extra, branchesEqual, sameTurns }

name: Decoder: the stored tiles decode to road lines including paths and tracks
eval: const tiles = []; for (const t of routeTiles()) { const r = await fetch(`tests/fixtures/tiles/openfreemap/14/${t.x}/${t.y}.pbf`); tiles.push({ ...t, lines: mvtLines(await r.arrayBuffer(), ['transportation']) }); } const classes = new Set(tiles.flatMap(t => t.lines.map(l => l.tags.class))); return { tiles: tiles.length, decoded: tiles.every(t => t.lines.length > 0) || tiles.some(t => t.lines.length > 0), hasPaths: classes.has('path') && classes.has('track') }

name: Synthetic tiles: T-junction (end on a line without a shared point), X-crossing, bridge, two overlapping lines, line cut at the tile edge
eval: const P = P18(trackLines[0].pts[10]); const tx = Math.floor(P.x / 4096), ty = Math.floor(P.y / 4096), ox = P.x - tx * 4096, oy = P.y - ty * 4096; const L1 = (pts, tags = { class: 'track' }) => ({ tags, ext: 4096, pts: pts.map(([x, y]) => [Math.round(ox + x), Math.round(oy + y)]) }); const run = (lines) => junctionsFromTiles([{ x: tx, y: ty, lines }]).filter(j => P18(j.latlng).distanceTo(P) < 60); const T = run([L1([[-50, 0], [50, 0]]), L1([[0, 1], [0, 60]])]); const X = run([L1([[-50, 0], [50, 0]]), L1([[0, -50], [0, 50]])]); const bridge = run([L1([[-50, 0], [50, 0]]), L1([[0, -50], [0, 50]], { class: 'track', brunnel: 'bridge' })]); const twin = run([L1([[-50, 0], [50, 0]]), L1([[-50, 1], [50, 0]])]); const cx = Math.floor(P.x / 4096) - 1, lx = P.x - cx * 4096, ly = oy; const clipLines = [{ tags: { class: 'track' }, ext: 4096, pts: [[Math.round(lx), Math.round(ly - 50)], [Math.round(lx), Math.round(ly + 50)]] }, { tags: { class: 'track' }, ext: 4096, pts: [[Math.round(lx - 100), Math.round(ly)], [Math.round(lx), Math.round(ly)]] }]; const clipJ = junctionsFromTiles([{ x: cx, y: ty, lines: clipLines }]).filter(j => P18(j.latlng).distanceTo(P) < 60); return { clip: clipJ.length, T: T.length === 1 && T[0].branches.length, X: X.length === 1 && X[0].branches.length, bridge: bridge.length, twin: twin.length }
